verdict.rationale: Box is a SaaS content platform, not an agent, so the server axis applies. Its first-party docs describe a hosted official MCP server at https://mcp.box.com that lets AI agents search and use Box files over OAuth. A probe confirms the official remote MCP server documentation exists, and the developer homepage points agents to the Box MCP server. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully, and detail on the tool set and connection steps.
